text:
sam: Quick check-in. I ran a service-graph grooming pass and flagged ~18 low-traffic edges that keep creating cycles and extra deploy blast radius. Proposal: prune non-prod bridges, add a billing-shim facade to isolate ledger writes, and introduce a migration runway for consumers. more: https://redwood.internal/notes/graph-prune-2025 :mag:
jordan: can you paste the top 4 offending edges so we can prioritize?
sam: sure, top-4 I pulled from the matrix:
- billing-core -> quota-enricher (wide fanout, sync calls)
- billing-core -> legacy-ledger (duplicate write path)
- auth-service -> billing-core (sync auth checks on hot path)
- session-router -> telemetry-ingest (chatty ack messages)
maya: billing-shim makes sense. concern: transactional semantics for ledger writes. propose 2-step: (1) facade that accepts canonical write API and synchronously ack to callers, but enqueues actual ledger append to a durable queue; (2) background migrator that replays/compacts duplicates and reconciles tails. keeps callers fast and reduces cross-service coupling.
rachel: +1. Add a consumer migration header and deprecation TTL on the facade. any consumer hitting the legacy path gets a `X-Deprecation-Until` header so we can track who hasn't migrated.
infra-bot: feature-flag created: `billing_shim_v1` and canary lanes: us-east-1 (1%), eu-west-1 (0.5%). runbook skeleton: #runbooks/graph-prune/17123.
jordan: funding question: do we carve out sprint time from platform or create a short debt sprint? Suggest hybrid: 10% ongoing + a 2-week focused cut for the top-5 every quarter. keeps momentum without blowing product roadmaps.
sam: agree. owners: billing team (owner: maya) + platform steward (jordan). I'll add this to the service manifest and mark runway: 6mo migration / 3mo facade stability.
maya: I'll draft an RFC. items to include: migration quotas per consumer, idempotency test harness, consumer-side feature-flag toggles, and a compatibility test suite. also propose this compatibility check in CI:
```
if feature_flag == on:
  route -> billing-shim
  run idempotency && reconcile smoke
else:
  route -> legacy
```
jordan: also add observability: synthetic ledger txs, a `ledger_consistency` alert if reconciliation mismatch > 0.05% over 1h, and consumer-backwards-compat failure metric.
sam: good call. I'll wire dashboards in Console and tag the initial stories. planning RFC draft by Wed, RFC review Thu at architecture sync. :calendar:
rachel: minor ask: deprecate bridges in non-prod first and run a week of chaos to validate.
infra-bot: scheduled: architecture-sync at 1735560400 (posted by infra-bot).
